newsitem.title: JAPAN: TABLE-JAPAN JUNE CORE MACHINERY ORDERS DOWN 10.6%.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-JAPAN JUNE CORE MACHINERY ORDERS DOWN 10.6%.

text.p: Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 10.6 percent in June from the previous month to 1.1 trillion yen, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Friday.
The EPA said it expected private machinery orders in the same category to rise 2.2 percent in the July-September quarter from the previous quarter. Orders rose 1.8 percent in the April-June quarter.
